title: Provincial Service Tribunals Extension of Provisions of the Constitution Act 1974

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Service Tribunals Extension of Provisions of the Constitution Act 1974
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 1974
ACT
XXXII OF 1974
PROVINCIAL SERVICE TRIBUNALS
(EXTENSION OF PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION) ACT, 1974
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the
Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act.
1974.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Service Tribunals Extension of Provisions of the Constitution Act 1974
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act LXX of 1973

ACT XXXII OF 1974
ACT
XXXII OF 1974
PROVINCIAL SERVICE TRIBUNALS
(EXTENSION OF PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION) ACT, 1974
2. Provisions
of Article 212 (2) to extend to Provincial
Service Tribunals.‑The
provisions of clause (2) of Article 212 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan shall extend to the Service Tribunals respectively
established under Acts of the Provincial Assemblies of the North West Frontier Province, the Punjab and Sind.
